svg.aria-label: The actual same-spin two-fermion pair density vanishes on the diagonal, whereas an independent product of the same marginals does not. Both integrate to two ordered pairs.
svg.title: The actual same-spin two-fermion pair density vanishes on the diagonal, whereas an independent product of the same marginals does not. Both integrate to two ordered pairs.

g.text: Both integrate to 2; only the actual pair density has an exchange node.
